name: final-ii-28l-zs
setup: set -e; E=/opt/twin/babylm/eval; mkdir -p $E; gsutil -q cp __BUCKET__/code/dev_bpw_twin_ref-0026.py $E/dev_bpw_twin.py; echo  | base64 -d | gunzip > $E/dev_bpw.py; printf '%s  %s\n' ad43c239fa2a47605c246748fee795a3070e0ad09f68cdc18eb0a880208bab07 $E/dev_bpw_twin.py 6700b76d1e2fd3b9e186871b11451be38a1efb3c8dd9f3594b8439e693566623 $E/dev_bpw.py | sha256sum -c -
note: Ruler final table priority (ii), 28L retrain set (torch 2.9.1 training; official eval in the pipeline venv). Code @ref-0171. Executor fills __URI_<member>__ = <retrain VM out>/babylm/runs/<member>/score/hf and __MIX_REF_pXY__ = the reads/rt28 full raw mixture DEV. GLUE is sequential (FT_PARALLEL=0): the S identity check was MISMATCH on multirc (ftverify @ref-0194), so no concurrent GLUE and no 28L identity check. Guard caveat: MIX_REF comes from the retrain VM's twin (torch 2.9.1); the guard recomputes it in the pipeline venv; a FAIL at |diff| ~1e-5..1e-4 would be a torch-eval difference, report it before voiding. bin ZS (experimenter 15:10Z: zero-shot first): official zero-shot + binding twin guard of the 3 K=2 mixtures (ZS_ONLY=1); singles' zero-shot is x0's zs jobs. maxdur 3. Pool ruler. EXECUTOR: project-c only; dev_bpw ref-0163 embedded (sha-checked).
